# How Orbital Foundry keeps product data ready for automation

Data publikacji: 2026-09-01

![Workshop floor](https://cdn.example/media/hero.png)

Clean product data is the cheapest **automation** you will ever buy. Orbital Foundry learned it the *hard* way.

## Start with an attribute audit

Count the attributes that are empty, duplicated or written in three different units. See the [audit guide](https://example.com/audit) and the `attribute_set` field.

- completeness per category
- consistency of units
* one owner per attribute

## Agree on one source of truth

| Area | Owner | Review |
| --- | --- | :---: |
| Attributes | Catalogue team | weekly |
| Descriptions | Content team | monthly |

### Keep the review short

A fifteen-minute review beats a quarterly clean-up.

![Review board](https://cdn.example/media/board.png)

## Automate the boring parts

Only automate a step that is measurable, repeatable and fed with structured data.

## FAQ

### Where should we start?

With an audit of completeness and consistency.

### Will automation fix bad data?

No. Clean the data first, then automate.
- it scales whatever it is given
